description: PTV Discovery Coach — ROI Calculator. Aligned to PTV Global Discovery Playbook. Captures all value streams, supports miles/km and multi-currency.
source: PTV Global Discovery & Value Engineering Workbook + Global Financial Baseline Calculator

distance.note: Confirm with customer at session start

vehiclesOperatingDaily.label: Vehicles Operating Daily
vehiclesOperatingDaily.discoveryQuestion: How many vehicles does your fleet operate on a typical day?

averageDistancePerRoute.label: Average Distance per Route
averageDistancePerRoute.discoveryQuestion: What is the average distance per route in miles (or km)?

operatingDaysPerYear.label: Operating Days per Year
operatingDaysPerYear.discoveryQuestion: How many days per year does your fleet operate?

averageStopsPerRoute.label: Average Stops per Route
averageStopsPerRoute.discoveryQuestion: What is the average number of stops per route?

numberOfDCs.label: Number of DCs / Branches
numberOfDCs.discoveryQuestion: How many distribution centers or branches do you operate?

numberOfPlanners.label: Number of Route Planners
numberOfPlanners.discoveryQuestion: How many people are involved in route planning today?

planningHoursPerDayPerPlanner.label: Planning Time per Planner per Day
planningHoursPerDayPerPlanner.discoveryQuestion: How many hours per day does each planner spend on routing?

overtimeHoursPerDriverPerWeek.label: Overtime Hours per Driver per Week
overtimeHoursPerDriverPerWeek.discoveryQuestion: How many overtime hours per week does the average driver run?

idleHoursPerVehiclePerDay.label: Estimated Idle Time per Vehicle per Day
idleHoursPerVehiclePerDay.discoveryQuestion: How much idle time does a typical vehicle accumulate per day?

inboundStatusCallsPerDay.label: Inbound Delivery Status Calls per Day
inboundStatusCallsPerDay.discoveryQuestion: How many inbound calls does your team handle daily related to delivery status?

onTimeDeliveryPct.label: Current On-Time Delivery Rate
onTimeDeliveryPct.discoveryQuestion: What is your current on-time delivery rate?

fullyLoadedCostPerDistanceUnit.label: Fully Loaded Cost per Mile (or km)
fullyLoadedCostPerDistanceUnit.note: Include fuel, driver labor, maintenance, depreciation, insurance
fullyLoadedCostPerDistanceUnit.discoveryQuestion: What is your fully loaded cost per mile (or km) — including fuel, labor, maintenance, and overhead?

plannerFullyLoadedHourlyRate.label: Planner Fully Loaded Hourly Rate
plannerFullyLoadedHourlyRate.discoveryQuestion: What is the fully loaded hourly cost of a route planner (salary + benefits + overhead)?

driverOvertimeHourlyRate.label: Driver Overtime Hourly Rate
driverOvertimeHourlyRate.discoveryQuestion: What is the driver overtime rate (typically 1.5× base rate)?

fuelCostPerGallon.label: Fuel Cost per Gallon (or Liter)
fuelCostPerGallon.discoveryQuestion: What is your current fuel cost per gallon (or liter)?

annualCreditWriteoffs.label: Annual Customer Credit Write-offs
annualCreditWriteoffs.discoveryQuestion: How much do you write off annually in customer credits due to delivery disputes, shorts, or damages?

grossMarginPct.label: Gross Margin %
grossMarginPct.note: Used to translate savings into revenue equivalent for executive framing
grossMarginPct.discoveryQuestion: What is your approximate gross margin percentage? (Used to frame savings as revenue equivalent)

ptvPricePerVehiclePerMonth.label: PTV Price per Vehicle per Month
ptvPricePerVehiclePerMonth.note: Adjust based on contract — standard is $100/vehicle/month

contractTermMonths.label: Contract Term
contractTermMonths.note: Multi-year contracts typically unlock better pricing

distanceReduction.label: Distance Reduction (Route Optimization)
distanceReduction.benchmark: PTV customers typically see 8-15% distance reduction. Strategic re-routes alone deliver 15-20%.

planningLaborSavings.label: Planning Labor Savings
planningLaborSavings.note: PTV reduces planning time to ~15 min/day (0.25 hours). Remaining time shifts to exception management.
planningLaborSavings.benchmark: 30-60% planning productivity improvement. Typically saves 1-3 hours per planner per day.

overtimeReduction.label: Driver Overtime Reduction
overtimeReduction.note: Better routes reduce overtime by 20-30%. Capture: fleet size × overtime hours × rate × 52 weeks.
overtimeReduction.benchmark: We typically see 30 min/driver/day of buffer removed with plan vs. actual reporting.

fuelSavings.label: Fuel Savings (Telematics / Idle Reduction)
fuelSavings.note: 1 hour of idle time = 1 gallon of fuel. Speed reduction of 5 MPH = 0.5 MPG improvement.
fuelSavings.benchmark: 15% fuel efficiency improvement typical with telematics deployment.

digitalPODSavings.label: Digital POD / Paperless Delivery Savings
digitalPODSavings.note: Total annual stops = vehicles × stopsPerRoute × operatingDays. $0.75/stop is the standard benchmark.
digitalPODSavings.benchmark: $0.75-$1.00 per stop in paper, processing, and credit savings when going digital.

creditReduction.label: Customer Credit Reduction
creditReduction.note: Digital POD with scanning and signature capture eliminates ~60% of disputed credits.
creditReduction.benchmark: Scanning and signature capture at delivery eliminates most short and damage disputes.

csrLaborSavings.label: CSR Labor Savings (Reduced Status Calls)
csrLaborSavings.note: 5 minutes per call average. Real-time tracking and proactive notifications eliminate 70-80% of status calls.
csrLaborSavings.benchmark: Real-time ETAs and proactive notifications typically reduce inbound status calls by 70-80%.

calculations.totalAnnualSavings: Sum of all value stream savings
calculations.ebitImpact: totalAnnualSavings (direct EBIT improvement — cost reduction flows directly to EBIT)

executiveFraming.note: Always present savings in three ways: (1) annual dollar savings, (2) ROI %, (3) revenue equivalent. A $500K saving at 5% margin = $10M in revenue equivalent — a powerful executive framing.
executiveFraming.co2Note: Route optimization reduces CO2 proportionally to distance reduction. An 8-15% distance reduction = 8-15% CO2 reduction. Relevant for sustainability KPIs and ESG reporting.

ManufacturingDistribution.referenceStatement: $100M savings per 100 trucks over contract life

FoodBeverageFMCG.additionalValue: Comingling optimization, temperature compliance, backhaul revenue

ThirdPartyLogistics.additionalValue: Multi-client optimization, carrier selection, freight audit 3-7% of spend

FieldServices.additionalValue: Dynamic scheduling, first-time fix rate improvement
